title: Königstein Fortress
geometryBasis: The named 163-control fortress perimeter, 51 mapped buildings and walls, and eight mapped western approach ways guide the exterior.
sectionBasis: The original Saxony DGM1 elevation controls wall and building contact. The Qualla Friedrichsburg and CC0 Georgenburg originals help set silhouette and visible finish.
limitations: The named perimeter follows the fortress edge. Visible parapet heights and where masonry becomes sandstone are approximate. The narrower plateau walls and lower western works follow the separate terrain elevation bands.

The native building polygons set plan, and selected OpenStreetMap heights help size principal masses. Roof shapes, many floor heights and window or dormer positions are estimates, especially for unmapped distinctions within connected buildings.
The scope is the exterior and visible mouths of the western passages. Underground rooms, artifacts and decorative text are outside this model.
